title: Chapter 304
text:
Clang!

The heavy chains fell to the ground, and Kerlodd let out a sigh of relief. He moved his arms and legs, looked down at his naked body, and said awkwardly, "Can I …"

A set of clothes was thrown at him, and Kerlodd hurriedly put them on. The feeling of being naked made him very embarrassed.

Han Xiao stared at Kerlodd with a smile the whole time. Kerlodd's personal account had the universal currency. Calling the Galactic Travel Agency required money, and Han Xiao was not sure if the other party would accept the payment, so getting the universal currency was a guarantee.

Furthermore, he did not want to kill Kerlodd. Although he had the upper hand now, Godora definitely knew that an investigator had come to Blue Star and unexpectedly went missing. After a while, they would contact the Six Nations to ask about the situation and even send a new investigation team.

If he killed Kerlodd, the conflict would escalate. There was no need to be so extreme. Killing someone for money was not a good habit. As long as Kerlodd was kept alive, the matter would not escalate from a personal issue to something more serious. As long as no one died, Godora would not care about the small danger that the Investigators encountered. This small conflict was nothing.

Of course, although Kerlodd had made a promise, Han Xiao was not completely unprepared. At least in Blue Star, he would not let Kerlodd out of his sight, and he would not return any equipment to him.

Because he was deliberately mystifying, Kerlodd thought that Han Xiao was also from the other side of the universe and did not know his identity, so he did not dare to act rashly.

Kerlodd asked again, "Who are you?"

"Alien," Han Xiao said perfunctorily.

Humans were a huge race in Galaxy, and there were countless branches. Kerlodd observed that Han Xiao seemed to be the most common alien human. He scratched his head and said, "Okay, I won't ask anymore. When are you going to leave? I want to go home as soon as possible."

"Not too long."

Han Xiao was going to pack up the top players in Blue Star. The Division League would end soon, and he could afford to wait.

Kerlodd suddenly said, "Oh right, where's my spaceship?"

"Someone picked it up. I don't think they'll return it to you." Han Xiao was well aware of what happened after that. Just by the fact that the Dark Net's intelligence personnel did not manage to obtain any information about the spaceship's crash, they knew that Raylan had blocked the news. It was clear what they wanted to do.

Kerlodd was frustrated. He did not want to contact the Six Nations. He did not want to take the risk. Also, he felt that Han Xiao was also a Galactic, so they would have a common topic. It would be easier for them to communicate with each other.

"What's wrong with your spaceship?" Han Xiao asked.

"I don't know. I was flying fine in stealth mode, but when we were about to reach the Blue Star, the engine suddenly stopped working, and I fell. The Observer's spaceship is not big, but its functions are very stable. I don't know why it suddenly malfunctioned."

Han Xiao fell into deep thought.

Shaking his head, Han Xiao started to get down to business. He turned on his communicator and registered his personal account. The communicator also had the function of a personal terminal. There was a lot of account functions, including the function of bank transfer. This was the most commonly used transaction method in the universe, convenient and fast. Every civilization had their own galactic bank, and the most authoritative ones were naturally the banks of the three Universal Civilizations. They had the most users, and the banks were connected to each other. They could be used anywhere in the universe.

Han Xiao randomly chose one and asked Kerlodd to transfer the money.

Ding!

"Your account has been transferred 878 Enas," the terminal said in a pleasant synthetic female voice.

"So little? You're too poor," Han Xiao could not help but complain.

Enas was the universal currency, the most commonly used unit of currency in the universe.

Kerlodd's face turned red. "I don't have the habit of saving money. Being an investigator is a tough job. I need to enjoy … Wait, why am I explaining to you?"

He suddenly realized that he was the one being robbed. Why did he feel embarrassed because he did not have enough money? What's wrong with him!

With the money in hand and the goal accomplished, Han Xiaoxin calmed down. He calculated the days. The Blue Star Division Finals were still in a dozen days, so he could contact the Galactic Travel Agency in advance.

There were hundreds of channels on the communicator. Han Xiao searched and entered the 'Garton Star System Travel Service Channel'. The screen showed a long list of travel routes, and a cold synthetic voice sounded.

"Do you want to filter?"

"Confirm."

"Your location?"

"Blue Star, Star Zone 9."

"Destination?"

Han Xiao paused and said, "Juberly Hub."

"Please select your price."

"The cheapest one." Han Xiao glanced at Kerr Tyrant Lodd.

"Number?"

"Dozens."

"Race?"

"Human."

"Have you ever used the Galactic Travel Agency before?"

"Yes."

After answering more than twenty questions, Han Xiao finally filtered out the results. There were only five travel agencies left. Galactic Travel Agency was a very broad service, and many large corporations provided this service. It was one of the cheapest ways to travel in the galaxy, almost like a private car. To be more precise, it was more like a 'public spaceship'.

Han Xiao had his eyes on the Short Horn Star travel agency. This was a very reputable Galactic Travel Agency. After choosing, he connected the communicator to the Short Horn Star salesperson's line so that both parties could discuss the details in person.

"Hello, thank you for choosing the Short Horn Star. We will provide you with the best service at the best price …"

The salesperson was a beautiful human female. According to the customer's race, the customer would be assigned to a salesperson who fit their aesthetic standards. After the female salesperson finished the welcome opening speech, she said, "We have accepted your travel conditions. Fortunately, a Whale-Class warship will pass by Star Zone 9 in twenty days. We will pick you up then. What kind of seat would you like? We have economy class, premium class class, VIP class, super VIP class and VIP class for you to choose from."

"How much is the economy class?"

"Three Enas per person. How many seats do you want?"

"About fifty." Han Xiao calculated. He only needed to bring about fifty of the top ranked players. Bringing along some players was a very important part of the plan.

After paying the deposit and confirming the boarding time, Han Xiao nodded. His preparations to travel into the galaxy were complete. His destination was Juberly Hub. This was the transit station of the Garton Star System. It was very convenient, and many races in the Colton Star Cluster gathered there. There were many opportunities there. According to Han Xiao's plan, Juberly Hub was the most suitable place to be the first stop in the galaxy.

Next, I just need to wait for the players to finish their matches, and I will be able to build a team. Everything is ready, and I only need time, Han Xiao thought to himself.

Furthermore, before he left, there were still some things that he needed to deal with on the Blue Star.

…

For the next few days, Han Xiao quietly moved the resources and brought Kerlodd with him. He made him wear a cloak that covered his skin and occasionally appeared in front of the people in the Sanctuary. They were curious as to why there was a mysterious person around Han Xiao.

In the Singles, Mad Blade was up against Li Ge. Before the competition, Mad Blade's performance was very surprising. After five rounds, he barely defeated Li Ge with a score of three to two. This time, Mad Blade fully displayed the style of a Mechanical Pugilist. He had been practicing his power hammer in secret, but he had not used it yet. This time, he finally took it out. The explosive power was even stronger than that of a Pugilist, and he broke through Li Ge's defense.

After Mad Blade entered the top four of the Singles, all the haters disappeared. Victory was the best confidence. His title of 'China's Number One Mechanical Pugilist' became more and more famous on the forums. He was considered the biggest dark horse in the first season of the Pro League!

Li Ge did not expect that he would die in Frenzied Sword's hands. When it rains, it pours. Temple of God made it into the top four and met Long Sky. This time, Hao Tian gave it his all and defeated Temple of God to enter the finals.

The situation was clear. Long Sky and Dynasty would fight for the first and second place of the Division, and Temple of God could only fight for the third place with another top four team. In the Singles, if there were no accidents, Mad Blade would very likely enter the top three and qualify for the international competition. As for the champion, it was not that Han Xiao looked down on Mad Blade, but Dynasty's King Admiral was just too strong. His skills, mechanics, and personal attributes were almost invincible in Version 1.0. Dynasty had the momentum to win the Double Championship, and the media was very optimistic.

However, even so, Mad Blade's results and fame were much better than in Han Xiao's previous life. Training him was not a waste.

After playing in the Division League for about half a year, the highest level players had already reached the upper limit of level 60.

Just as Han Xiao was secretly preparing, Bennett suddenly called.

"I'm already at Sanctuary Three. Where are you?"

"Why are you suddenly here?" Han Xiao joked. "Did you miss me?"

"What do you think?" Bennett's tone was serious. "Where did you hide that alien? You didn't eat it, did you? "

Han Xiao's smile disappeared, and he frowned. "Huang Jian told you?"
